Kato Moni, Nicosia

Homemade Cypriot food

A family village tavern in Kato Moni with a garden, a view and meze cooked like at home. On Google, 4.6 stars from 181 reviews.

Food

What comes to the table

From what guests write in their Google reviews.

Meze

One dish after another: salad, lamb, afelia, sausage, eggs with tomatoes and asparagus.

Vegetarian dishes

Mushrooms with onion and wine and zucchini balls, guests name among the vegetarian dishes.

Makaronia tou fournou

Baked pasta that one guest calls the first they ever enjoyed at a tavern, fresh and full of flavour.

Sunday meze

On Sundays a set meze menu for the table, best booked ahead because it is a small family place.

Veranda and table

Photos from the Google listing.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Like visiting family

A family tavern where guests feel at home. 19 reviews mention the kind owner.

Garden and view

Flowers and fruit trees, a view on both sides and the sunset with a cold drink, guests write.

Children welcome

Play corners for children in the garden, and the tavern cats in the back yard.

In Kato Moni

At Archiepiskopou Kyprianou 16Z in Kato Moni, outside Nicosia. Open at lunchtime from Wednesday to Sunday.

What guests say

Three of 181 Google reviews, 143 of them with five stars.

“One of the most beautiful village taverns in Cyprus. Excellent food, amazing service in a perfect countryside scene, reminds us of an old time movie. The place is so homey that we almost felt like visiting some kind of relatives in Cyprus. Highly recommended!”

Google review
“Amazing homemade Cypriot food. Friendly family taverna with absolutely beautiful place to enjoy your meal. Warning food portions are gigantic 😃”

Google review
“The view from a restaurant is astonishing. The service is a perfect example of an awesome hospitality and the food is a traditional Greek/Cypriot cuisine done well.”
